digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and evidence banking workflow
propositions: Dense completion-verifier runs could exhaust bounded request budgets with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts instead of evidence-backed PASS/FAIL outcomes
Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, allowing prompt-only instructions to fail at enforcing serialized evidence commitment before budget exhaustion

A completion-only policy wrapper at the agent_call.py seam atomically claims one governed action per response step and invokes provisional met=false banking at the third evidence response if criterion remains unbanked
The merged finite-banking policy attached to both primary and successor completion paths restores the documented incremental-banking contract without adding dependencies or breaking public APIs
Held-out behavioral oracle demonstrated baseline 0/3 bounded success with policy disabled and repaired 2/3-or-better bounded success with policy enabled, while simple control maintained 3/3 PASS
